newsitem.title: USA: Pharmacia & Upjohn to market lab services.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia & Upjohn to market lab services.

text.p: Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc said it has agreed to market Oncotech Inc's oncology laboratory service jointly with Oncotech.
Pharmacia & Upjohn said it will pay Oncotech $5.5 million for co-marketing rights in North America and for an option to extend these rights to other markets.
The company said it will also support clinical trials of Oncotech's prognostic market tests and extreme drug resistance assay. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
